additional_info.subject: [MP / P3 170000416] Sessions Interrupted
additional_info.body:
Hi Siemens Support Team,
we’re currently experiencing issues with out charger MP / P3 170000416, which is mainly used for truck charging sessions.
Running sessions are interrupted after a couple of minutes, sessions only contain a few kilowtt hours.
Our CPMS reports a SuspendedEV state, then starts charging again.
Could you please check why the charger switches to suspendedEV mode? What has stopped the sessions from going on?
Customer complains about charging disruptions.
Kind regards,
Marius Schneider

additional_info.subject: ID0471762-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / P3 170000416] Sessions Interrupted Issue CRM:03288000113
additional_info.body:
Dear Marius,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support.
The session initiated correctly but was temporarily paused during a routine safety check. While this process is typically seamless, in this instance the system could not immediately communicate with the DC1 and DC2 groups, causing a brief interruption before power delivery could resume.
Best regards,
Ivan
Siemens eMobility Technical Support Team
